name: neumorphism-ui
description: Same-hue soft-extrusion restyling — the soft-and-physical language in which the surface is THE SAME COLOUR AS THE PAGE GROUND, with no texture and no material. Emits a neumorphic token layer with a five-rung dual-shadow ramp at blur = 2 x distance, rewrites controls to extruded and pressed surfaces, and ships the clean-neumorphism variant: a real 3:1 hairline carries the boundary because no same-hue shadow pair can, and a forced-colors block restores the structure box-shadow deletion removes. A surface with its own pastel fill is claymorphism-ui; one imitating a material is skeuomorphism-ui.
